title: Playing the lakefront camps and floods
summary: Clayton played weekends at Milneburg camps, walking through backwater when storm tides flooded the boardwalk.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Did you ever play out at Millenburg? Oh, yes.

I used to play out there every Sunday, Saturday. We was playing at the Law Cabin or either at Sam's Camp, and people used to be like that. Sometimes the tires would come in and we had to walk in water about a mile to get to the road. Really? Yeah, the tires would come in backwater, you know. Did they come over the boardwalk? That's right, come over the boardwalk. We had to walk in the water. Oh.
That's right. I didn't know. Did they flood the little camps, the buildings?
That's right. Flood, they'd flood them. We had to come out there.
That wasn't the regular tide each night or did you see?
Like a hurricane guy or something.
